import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os
import warnings

# Disable lightgbm progress bars
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
lgb.log_evaluation(0)

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Check file sizes
print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Split training data into train/validation (80/20 split for hold-out)
train_data, val_data = train_test_split(
    train_df, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=train_df["target"]
)

# Prepare features
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "target"]]

X_train = train_data[feature_cols]
y_train = train_data["target"]
X_val = val_data[feature_cols]
y_val = val_data["target"]
X_test = test_df[feature_cols]

# Identify categorical and numeric columns
cat_col = "f_27"
numeric_cols = [
    col
    for col in feature_cols
    if col != cat_col and train_df[col].dtype in ["int64", "float64"]
]
object_cols = [col for col in feature_cols if train_df[col].dtype == "object"]

print(f"Categorical columns: {object_cols}")
print(f"Numeric columns: {numeric_cols}")

# Create interaction features between numeric columns
# Select top 10 numeric columns by variance to create interactions
numeric_cols_with_var = numeric_cols.copy()
for col in numeric_cols:
    var = X_train[col].var()
    if pd.notna(var):
        numeric_cols_with_var.append(col)
    else:
        numeric_cols_with_var.remove(col)

# Sort by variance and take top 15
numeric_cols_with_var = sorted(
    numeric_cols_with_var,
    key=lambda x: X_train[x].var() if X_train[x].var() else 0,
    reverse=True,
)[:15]

# Create interaction features between numeric columns (excluding the categorical col)
interaction_cols = []
for i, num_col1 in enumerate(numeric_cols_with_var):
    for j, num_col2 in enumerate(numeric_cols_with_var):
        if i < j:
            int_col = f"{num_col1}x{num_col2}"
            X_train[int_col] = X_train[num_col1] * X_train[num_col2]
            X_val[int_col] = X_val[num_col1] * X_val[num_col2]
            X_test[int_col] = X_test[num_col1] * X_test[num_col2]
            interaction_cols.append(int_col)

print(f"Created {len(interaction_cols)} interaction features")


# Frequency encode the categorical feature
def frequency_encode(df, col):
    freq = df[col].value_counts(normalize=True)
    return df[col].map(freq)


cat_col = "f_27"
X_train[cat_col] = frequency_encode(X_train, cat_col)
X_val[cat_col] = frequency_encode(X_val, cat_col)
X_test[cat_col] = frequency_encode(X_test, cat_col)

# Create LightGBM datasets
lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=lgb_train)

# Hyperparameters (using the best from previous solution)
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.9,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "random_state": 42,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
}

# Train model
print("Training LightGBM model with interaction features...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_set=lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[lgb_val],
    valid_names=["valid"],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False)],
)

# Evaluate on validation set
print("Evaluating on validation set...")
val_preds = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate test predictions
print("Generating test predictions...")
test_preds = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df["id"], "target": test_preds})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with {len(submission)} rows")
